patterns: APPSC asks direct recall: President is the nominal (not real) head of executive; statement set on presidential features (head of State, head of Government, directly elected; NOT accountable to legislature).

Recurring facts across PSCs: non-member minister must get elected within six months; Council of Ministers responsible to Parliament (Lok Sabha); presidential system originated in USA; single executive is the basic presidential feature.

Assertion-Reason shape: 'India is parliamentary because executive is responsible to legislature' - both true, R explains A; main advantage of parliamentary form = executive responsibility to legislature.
App MCQs go deeper than PYQs into India-UK-USA comparisons, semi-presidential countries, ONOE and Shamsher Singh; PYQs stay at definition/feature level.
